name: Sothera
description: Sothera is a star system on the fringes of the known universe, with a supervoid at its heart that the Monoists made by killing the star.

description_citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 1" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.

citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

status.text: As of the latest events Sothera remains a supervoid system contested by the Monoists, the Sunstar Free Company and others, with Tezzeret tracing a crystal over a map of it.

citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: A narrator voice asks the reader to make choices that keep the story going, including leaving the Metalman unable to retrieve it.
timeline.quote: I need you to prevent the Metalman from retrieving me.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 1" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The Monoists kill Sothera into a supervoid rather than let it explode into a supernova.
timeline.quote: So, they killed the star.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 1" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The Seriema approaches Sigma's Reach from the east at sunset of Sothera's black hole.
timeline.quote: Sothera is now a supervoid, a black hole sun.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 1" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Pinnacle, drawn by the Kav's furious emigration, comes to Sothera, builds the eternity column Infinite Guideline and opens the system to the Edge.
timeline.quote: We came to Sothera, constructed an FTL outpost—an eternity column designated Infinite Guideline —and opened the system to the rest of the connected Edge.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Edge of Eternities
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Jay Annelli, Laurel Pratt, Amanda LaFranco. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The Monoists capture Sothera's collapse and turn it inward into a supervoid, making it their thousandth.
timeline.quote: Sothera is that thousandth supervoid.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Edge of Eternities
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Jay Annelli, Laurel Pratt, Amanda LaFranco. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The Palatinate sends Sunstar Free Company knights to stop the Monoists and deploy a horizon javelin at Sothera.
timeline.quote: the Palatinate has dispatched a force of Sunstar Free Company knights to drive the Monoists out and deploy one of their javelins

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Edge of Eternities
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Jay Annelli, Laurel Pratt, Amanda LaFranco. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: In a dream, Alpharael falls into Sothera after his sister Raphaella and begs her to turn back.
timeline.quote: Of course we're sure, Alph. We were always going to do this.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 3" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Raphaella is torn apart on the horizon, and Alpharael realizes there is no Next Eternity, only hell.
timeline.quote: There is no Next Eternity. There is only hell.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 3" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Raphaella's final transmission explains the Monoist purpose, describes the Dawnsire and Candela, and bids farewell as her inevitor falls toward Sothera.
timeline.quote: that we will destroy the Dawnsire

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 3" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The Monoist inevitors launch toward the Dawnsire, and Alpharael learns they will hit at thirty kilometers a second.
timeline.quote: We hit it at thirty kilometers a second.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 3" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Inside an inevitor, Alpharael learns the names of his fellow boarders, all Monoists bound for paradise.
timeline.quote: After he finishes screaming, Alpharael learns a few names.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 4" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Alpharael insists his sister Raphaella, chosen for the Plummet, is no heretic.
timeline.quote: "My sister's not a heretic," Alpharael protests.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 4" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The Monoists recite the prayer of gravity together.
timeline.quote: "This is the grace of gravity," someone says.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 4" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Alpharael's warmaker burns away from the Dawnsire, unremarked by anyone.
timeline.quote: And if any of those eyes take note of the Hopelight warmaker burning furiously away from the Dawnsire , headed anywhere but home—they do not say.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 4" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Alpharael plays along, claiming the Free Company plans to destroy Sothera.
timeline.quote: The Sunstar Free Company plans to destroy Sothera

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam explains his belief that an anathema object in Sothera is calling for a wielder and threatens the Sunstar mission.
timeline.quote: I believe one such object is in Sothera.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 7" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret drops a crystal over a map of Sothera and it rolls to a libratory point near Uthros.
timeline.quote: He pinches it between two of his claw-fingers, lifts it above the map, and lets go.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: A narrator describes alternate branches for where the crystal might point, rejects each, and says to go back and choose better.
timeline.quote: Go back and make a better choice.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 9" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Following the Phyrexian invasion, Tezzeret was ejected from the Blind Eternities into the Edge by unknown means.
timeline.quote: He was ejected from the Blind Eternities by methods still unknown.

citation.work: The Legends of Edge of Eternities
citation.text: "The Legends of Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Amanda LaFranco, Laurel Pratt, Jay Annelli. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret works to found a criminal consortium in the Edge.
timeline.quote: all while aiming to lay the foundations of a criminal consortium.

citation.work: The Legends of Edge of Eternities
citation.text: "The Legends of Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Amanda LaFranco, Laurel Pratt, Jay Annelli. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Exiled Tannuk joined Sami's crew and is now its last remaining member.
timeline.quote: Exiled from his people, Tannuk joined Sami and found the young captain to be as passionate about their crew as Tannuk was about his people.

citation.work: The Legends of Edge of Eternities
citation.text: "The Legends of Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Amanda LaFranco, Laurel Pratt, Jay Annelli. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya traveled to Sothera aboard the Dawnsire, which will reignite the supervoid.
timeline.quote: She traveled there aboard the Dawnsire , a horizon javelin and kilometers-long vessel that will reignite the Sotheran supervoid—something the system's Monoists will do anything to prevent.

citation.work: The Legends of Edge of Eternities
citation.text: "The Legends of Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Amanda LaFranco, Laurel Pratt, Jay Annelli. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Haliya pledged her bladiator to Syr Vondam's service.
timeline.quote: Haliya has pledged her bladiator to the service of Syr Vondam, her mentor and idol who has trained her since she was a young woman.

citation.work: The Legends of Edge of Eternities
citation.text: "The Legends of Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Amanda LaFranco, Laurel Pratt, Jay Annelli. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Vondam commands a knightly host assigned to defend the Dawnsire.
timeline.quote: Syr Vondam is a high-ranking knight of the Sunstar Free Company who commands a knightly host assigned to defend the Dawnsire .

citation.work: The Legends of Edge of Eternities
citation.text: "The Legends of Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Amanda LaFranco, Laurel Pratt, Jay Annelli. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Abandoned on a moon, Dyadrine grafts local flora onto itself.
timeline.quote: After years of analysis, the mechan determined that local flora contained sufficient structural integrity from which to graft repairs onto themself.

citation.work: The Legends of Edge of Eternities
citation.text: "The Legends of Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Amanda LaFranco, Laurel Pratt, Jay Annelli. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Kav scrappers send Val's ship crashing onto an unexplored jungle world.
timeline.quote: Val has transmitted this message daily ever since a fateful run-in with Kav scrappers sent her ship hurtling to the surface of an unexplored jungle world.

citation.work: The Legends of Edge of Eternities
citation.text: "The Legends of Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Amanda LaFranco, Laurel Pratt, Jay Annelli. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Axavar severs his contract as a Drix Eldrazi hunter.
timeline.quote: So Axavar severed his contract and his fate.

citation.work: The Legends of Edge of Eternities
citation.text: "The Legends of Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Amanda LaFranco, Laurel Pratt, Jay Annelli. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2025.

relations.quote: You still have Sothera's richest world.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 5" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jun 2025.

pages_say.description: A star that was to go nova but was killed by the Monoists into a supervoid, ringed with violet light, with children worlds around it.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 1" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.

pages_say.description: The supervoid at the heart of the Sothera system, once a young star about to go nova, collapsed by the Monoists as their thousandth supervoid and ringed by a photon collar.
